documents.unit: Chief Information Officer / AI Governance and Risk Committee
documents.title: HSC OP 52.21, Acceptable Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Tools
documents.summary: An operating policy for the whole health sciences center covering education, research, clinical care and administration. It allows AI use under principles of disclosure, accountability, privacy and human supervision, bans AI on protected data without a contract, and sets up a governance committee. Coursework rules are thin: academic work is limited only where the instructor disallows AI.
documents.stance_why: Coders split (A permit, B delegates). The policy sets conditions rather than handing the choice to instructors: "AI use must be disclosed and documented appropriately", public data "may be used freely with AI tools", and only specific uses are barred. The single coursework clause bans AI use for "completion of academic work in a manner not allowed by the instructor", a narrow instructor-deferral inside a general permit-with-conditions policy covering education, research, clinical and administrative work. It is not restrict (AI is not banned by default) and not delegates (the policy sets rules itself), so permit.

units.anchor: subject to vendor licenses that may restrict AI use

units.resolution_why: A: all/during-work/should/P49/restrict. B: all/during-work/informs/P49/restrict. Coders split on modality (A should, B informs) and stance (A restrict, B restrict). units.why: 'Always confirm the accuracy of AI-generated information before relying on it', since outputs 'may be inaccurate, biased, or fabricated', so P31. [Reconciled final codes: actor all, phase during-work, modality must, type P31, unit_stance permit.]
units.anchor: Always confirm the accuracy of AI-generated information before relying on it.

units.resolution_why: A: all/during-work/must/P24/permit. B: all/general/must/P24/require. Coders split on phase and stance (A during-work/permit, B general/require). Disclosure is a condition on permitted use, so during-work and permit. Final: all/during-work/must/P24/permit.

units.why: 'Do not present AI-generated outputs as your own' forbids passing off AI output as one's work, so P19.
units.anchor: Do not present AI-generated outputs as your own.
units.fit_note: A: Framed as not presenting output as your own, rather than not submitting generated work at all. B: Applies to all users and all work products, not only submitted student work.
units.resolution_why: A: all/during-work/must-not/P19/prohibit. B: all/general/must-not/P19/prohibit. Coders split on phase (A during-work, B general). Output presented to others as work product, so during-work. Final: all/during-work/must-not/P19/prohibit.

units.why: 5g also says to 'ensure accuracy and avoid infringing on another party's intellectual property rights' when quoting or paraphrasing AI output, an IP rule (P52).
